exercises.title: U3 听力·对话 Booking a Flight
exercises.speaker: uk_female

transcript.speaker: Tina
transcript.text: Hello, I'd like to book a flight to Rome for next Friday.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Of course. Would you like a morning flight or an afternoon one?

transcript.speaker: Tina
transcript.text: A morning flight, please, so that I can have the whole day in the city.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: There is one that leaves at nine o'clock. The ticket costs two hundred pounds.

transcript.speaker: Tina
transcript.text: That sounds fine. Can I take one carry-on bag for free?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, one carry-on item is free, but a second bag has an extra fee.

transcript.speaker: Tina
transcript.text: All right, I'll only bring one. Could you book that morning flight for me?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Certainly. Your nine o'clock flight to Rome is now booked. Have a good trip!

exercises.translation_cn: Tina 想订下周五去罗马的机票;她要早班机,这样能玩一整天;九点的航班票价两百英镑;一件随身行李免费,第二件要额外收费;Tina 只带一件,订下了九点的航班。

questions.stem: Where does Tina want to fly to?
Why does Tina choose a morning flight?
options: So that she can have the whole day in the city.
Because there are no afternoon flights.

questions.stem: How much does the ticket cost?
What does the agent say about luggage?
options: One carry-on bag is free; a second has a fee.
Carry-on bags are not allowed at all.

questions.stem: Which flight does Tina finally book?

exercises.title: U3 听力·短文 What Travel Means
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: A wise man once told me to experience life to the fullest while you are young.
There is no better way to do this than by travelling.
When you travel, you see the beauty of the world with your own eyes.
Being away from home opens your heart and changes the way you think.
So whenever you have the chance, go and discover new places.
exercises.translation_cn: 一位智者曾告诉我,趁年轻时要尽情体验生活;没有比旅行更好的方式;旅行时,你用自己的眼睛看到世界之美;离开家会敞开你的心扉,改变你的思维方式;所以一有机会,就去探索新地方。

questions.stem: What did the wise man say to do while young?
According to the passage, what is the best way to do this?
What do you see when you travel?
options: The beauty of the world with your own eyes.

questions.stem: What does being away from home do?
options: It opens your heart and changes how you think.

questions.stem: What advice does the speaker give at the end?
options: Travel only when you are old.
Go and discover new places whenever you can.

exercises.title: U3 听力·对话 Checking in at a Hotel
exercises.speaker: uk_female

transcript.speaker: Clerk
transcript.text: Good evening, and welcome. Do you have a booking with us?

transcript.speaker: Mark
transcript.text: Yes, I booked a room for three nights under the name Mark Lee.

transcript.speaker: Clerk
transcript.text: Let me check. Yes, here it is. May I see your passport, please?

transcript.speaker: Mark
transcript.text: Here you are. Is breakfast included in the price?

transcript.speaker: Clerk
transcript.text: Yes, breakfast is served from seven to ten in the morning.

transcript.speaker: Mark
transcript.text: Great. Could you also tell me how to get to the old town?

transcript.speaker: Clerk
transcript.text: Of course. It's a short walk. Turn left when you leave the hotel.

transcript.speaker: Mark
transcript.text: Thank you so much. I can't wait to start exploring tomorrow.

exercises.translation_cn: Mark 用 Mark Lee 的名字订了三晚的房间;前台核对预订并查看护照;房价含早餐,早餐七点到十点供应;前台告诉他去老城的路:出酒店左转,步行很近;Mark 期待明天开始游览。

questions.stem: How many nights did Mark book?
What does the clerk ask to see?
When is breakfast served?
options: From seven to ten in the morning.

questions.stem: How can Mark get to the old town?
options: By taking a long bus ride.
By turning left and walking a short way.

questions.stem: How does Mark feel about the next day?
options: He can't wait to start exploring.
He is too tired to move.

exercises.title: U3 听力·短文 Advice for Young Travellers
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: If you are a teenager who dreams of travelling, here is some simple advice.
Dream big, but always stay practical about what you can do now.
Remember that a small setback will not stop you if you keep taking action.
Work hard, chart a course ahead, and then stick to your plan.
Step by step, your travel dream can slowly come true.
exercises.translation_cn: 如果你是个梦想旅行的青少年,这里有些简单的建议:敢于做大梦,但对当下能做的事要切合实际;记住,只要不断行动,小小的挫折阻止不了你;努力做事,提前规划路线,然后坚持计划;一步步地,你的旅行梦想就能慢慢实现。

questions.stem: Who is this advice for?
options: Only adults with lots of money.
A teenager who dreams of travelling.

questions.stem: What does the speaker say about dreaming?
What will not stop you, according to the passage?
options: A small setback, if you keep acting.

questions.stem: What three things should you do?
options: Work hard, chart a course, and stick to the plan.

questions.stem: How does a travel dream come true?

exercises.title: U3 听力·对话 Buying Souvenirs
exercises.speaker: uk_female

transcript.speaker: Lucy
transcript.text: Look at these little painted boxes. They'd make lovely gifts for my friends.

transcript.speaker: Ben
transcript.text: They are pretty, but the prices here seem a bit high to me.

transcript.speaker: Lucy
transcript.text: Do you think so? This one costs twenty pounds.

transcript.speaker: Ben
transcript.text: I saw the same boxes near the station for much less.

transcript.speaker: Lucy
transcript.text: Really? Then maybe we should walk there before I buy anything.

transcript.speaker: Ben
transcript.text: Good idea. It's always wise to compare prices when you buy souvenirs.

transcript.speaker: Lucy
transcript.text: You're right. I don't want to spend more than I need to.

transcript.speaker: Ben
transcript.text: Let's go and check. We still have plenty of time before dinner.

exercises.translation_cn: Lucy 看中一些手绘小盒子想送朋友;Ben 觉得这里价格偏高;一个要二十英镑;Ben 说在车站附近见过便宜得多的同款;两人决定先去那边比比价再买;比价是买纪念品的明智之举,他们晚饭前还有时间。

questions.stem: What does Lucy want to buy?
What does Ben think about the prices here?
options: They are the lowest in town.

questions.stem: Where did Ben see the same boxes for less?
What does Ben say is wise when buying souvenirs?
options: To buy the first thing you see.

questions.stem: What do they decide to do?
options: Walk to the other place to compare prices.

exercises.title: U3 听力·短文 Packing for a Trip
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Here is a useful tip for anyone who is getting ready for a journey.
The night before you leave, make a clear list of everything you need.
Try to pack light, because a heavy bag is hard to carry around.
Keep your passport and tickets where you can reach them easily.
With a little planning ahead, packing becomes quick and stress-free.
exercises.translation_cn: 给准备出行的人一个实用贴士:出发前一晚,把要带的东西列成清单;尽量轻装,因为重包不好带;把护照和机票放在容易拿到的地方;只要提前规划一点,收拾行李就会又快又轻松。

questions.stem: Who is this tip for?
options: Anyone getting ready for a journey.

questions.stem: What should you do the night before you leave?
options: Make a clear list of what you need.

questions.stem: Why should you pack light?
options: Because a heavy bag is hard to carry.

questions.stem: Where should you keep your passport and tickets?
options: Where you can reach them easily.

questions.stem: What does planning ahead do for packing?
options: It wastes a lot of time.
It has no effect at all.
It makes packing quick and stress-free.
